asked.item: Which n8n field holds LinkedIn poll options
Scheduling a LinkedIn poll for Monday

verdict.reason: The pages say Blotato doesn't support LinkedIn polls, including in the n8n node, so no poll options field exists.

steps.text: There is no field for poll options, because Blotato does not support publishing LinkedIn polls yet.
Blotato has not added poll publishing to the web app, API, n8n node, Make.com module, or MCP tools.
To publish a LinkedIn poll today, create it directly in LinkedIn or use another tool that supports LinkedIn poll publishing.
